profile.name: abu_jandal
profile.bio: I'm a 3rd-year cybersecurity student focused on low-level systems, Linux, and open‑source software. I organize my learning with the PARA method in Emacs and believe in building things to truly understand them — whether it's a memory allocator, a shell, or an ELF loader. I enjoy learning how things work under the hood, from syscalls to memory management, and applying that knowledge in practical projects. I use NixOS as my main driver with niri and a keyboard-driven setup.
